messages.safety.body1: This fictional preview explores organisation and practical support. It does not diagnose, recommend treatment, assess symptoms, change medication, or determine whether you need care. No one monitors your selections.
messages.safety.body2: Follow your clinician’s instructions. If you think you need urgent care, contact the appropriate local service directly; do not wait for this demo. A mood selection is not a health result. Missing or conflicting medical information needs clarification, not a guess.
messages.safety.body3: This is not an insurance product or a promise of care. Medical-device status for a future product depends on its intended purpose and functions; no certification is claimed.
messages.privacy.title: Privacy & your choices
messages.privacy.body1: The walkthrough uses invented information. Mood and energy choices stay in the current page’s memory, are not sent by the application, and reset when you reload. There is no health-record upload, account, analytics or persistent check-in storage in this demo.
messages.privacy.body2: The site is delivered through Cloudflare and hosted on Hetzner. These services process technical connection data, such as IP addresses, to deliver and protect the website. This is not a claim that visiting the site creates no technical records.
messages.privacy.body3: Do not submit personal health information through this demo or the public project repository. Real health tracking and family sharing are not enabled. A future service needs a complete privacy notice and verified data-protection arrangements before collecting health records.
